note: Every disputed edge, its objection, and the published outcome. Sources: cross-vendor audits (E6, E7) and reader disputes via the issue tracker. Outcomes: upheld (corrected/removed), partially-upheld, both-defensible (documented, no change), not-upheld.

disputes.objection: Paragraph names the filius regius, not Rex.
disputes.resolution: Edge deleted — near-duplicate of filius-regius —transforms-into→ anthropos anchored to the same sentence.
Reference moved to adam —identified-with→ prima-materia; overreach edge deleted.

disputes.objection: Paragraph supports blood generally (the green lion's), not human blood.
disputes.resolution: Subject retargeted to new node blood (auditor's cross-review pushed for the stronger fix over a confidence demotion).

disputes.objection: Text says 'the ego with its shadow' — not solely the shadow.
disputes.resolution: Object retargeted to the-ego; quote extended to the full phrase.

disputes.objection: Quote may be Jung's summary of Orthelius rather than a direct quotation.
disputes.resolution: Sentence sits in a translated quotation block; the doctrine is Orthelius's under either claim type. No change.

disputes.objection: Arguably Jung's own assertion rather than reported doctrine.
disputes.resolution: Sympathetic-exposition boundary — the same item class every model configuration finds ambiguous. No change.

disputes.objection: The term 'rebis' is absent from the paragraph.
disputes.resolution: 'Hermaphroditic Adam' maps to rebis under the graph's node-vocabulary convention. No change.
The bridal-chamber (thalamus) union imagery is the coniunctio content. No change.
'United with the mother… rebirth through a return to the womb' is the thesis without the word. No change.

disputes.objection: The referent is Crispis, not the inscription.
disputes.resolution: In Maier's reading the whole inscription's referent is the arcane substance.
Ellipsis splicing across adjacent sentences is permitted by the stated quotation rule; content fully supported.

disputes.objection: The queen drinks the lion's blood; the paragraph's amplification is queen ↔ whore of Babylon.
disputes.resolution: Relation corrected to drinks-blood-of; reclassified as reported Cantilena content.

disputes.objection: Paragraph names Purusha and Gayomart; Atman is absent.
disputes.resolution: Edge deleted — misanchored; the parallel must be re-mined with a correct anchor.

disputes.objection: The paragraph's 'filius unius diei' is not the filius regius; the designation is for the Hermaphrodite of nature, i.e. the arcane substance.
disputes.resolution: Subject retargeted to arcane-substance; quote re-anchored.

disputes.objection: The text states an equation ('a representation of the individuation process… what we today call active imagination'), not a symbolization.
The Diana identification depends on the previous paragraph.
disputes.resolution: Confidence downgraded to medium (single-paragraph judging context is a documented limit).
The second Adam ↔ Anthropos mapping is the graph's documented vocabulary convention (distinct from the first-Adam case upheld in E6). No change.
